provisional_readiness.name: chatgpt-manager-workflow
provisional_readiness.trigger: Route among multiple plausible ChatGPT top-level-manager capabilities when selection is ambiguous.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use after one explicit ChatGPT-local leaf already owns the task.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: The ChatGPT-local router selects a leaf; it does not compose assignments, execute work, or authorize a phase.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The client and repository own available capabilities, source identity, authority, and dispatch.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on unresolved authority, missing canonical metadata, or ambiguous duplicate-name provenance.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Canonical and route-map review plus bounded APG41 routing dogfood.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: Fresh client discovery and repeated non-hypothetical use remain limited.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the ChatGPT-local leaf, its projection and map entry, catalog and release entries, and focused tests while preserving phase history.

provisional_readiness.name: composing-approved-roadmap-assignments
provisional_readiness.trigger: Compose one manager assignment from a human-approved roadmap item with an allocated semantic phase identity.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not invent a roadmap, allocate authority, dispatch workers, or execute the assignment.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: Planning owns implementation decomposition and bounded-worker composition owns internal worker prompts.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The maintainer owns the approved roadmap item, phase identity, repository state, delivery policy, and successor boundary.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop when approval, identity, objective, acceptance, or stop boundary is missing.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Canonical contract, frozen cases, and APG41 owner-boundary review.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: Repeated ordinary use outside prepared APG phase assignments remains limited.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove only the ChatGPT-local leaf, projection, catalog and map surfaces, release entry, and focused tests.

provisional_readiness.name: converting-bash-scripts-to-python
provisional_readiness.trigger: Convert an existing Bash executable or script family to Python while preserving or deliberately migrating its observable contract.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use for new Python code, an unresolved design, or an edit that remains naturally Bash-owned.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: The conversion procedure owns contract migration; Bash and Python profiles supply language judgment independently.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The repository owns interpreter support, CLI compatibility, deployment, entry points, tests, dependencies, and cutover.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop when behavior cannot be characterized, destructive or live effects lack isolation, or compatibility authority is missing.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Canonical review and public-safe conversion scenario dogfood; no target cutover.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: No live target-repository conversion or deployment was performed in APG41.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the conversion leaf and integration surfaces; project migrations retain their own rollback and are not reversed automatically.

provisional_readiness.name: dockerfile-profile
provisional_readiness.trigger: Apply when Dockerfile parser, stage, context, transfer, mount, cache, ownership, runtime-metadata, or platform semantics are material.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use for ordinary application, Compose-only, orchestration-only, or generic shell work.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: Dockerfile structure remains separate from shell semantics, image selection, dependencies, runtime operation, and release policy.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The project owns frontend, builder, images, context, platform, commands, registry, network, cache, secrets, and runtime policy.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on protected context exposure, untrusted shell flow, ambiguous stage or source ownership, unsafe cache correctness, or false build claims.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Static simple, multi-stage, and adverse public-safe fixtures; no Docker operation.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: No daemon, pull, build, image inspection, runtime, registry, or platform execution was performed.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the leaf, projection, catalog, route, release and inventory entries, focused tests and fixture while retaining historical records.

provisional_readiness.name: go-cmp-test-profile
provisional_readiness.trigger: Apply only after a repository selects google/go-cmp v0.7.0 and semantic comparison options are material.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not select the dependency, handle another release without refresh, or own native Go test lifecycle or simple local equality.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: go-cmp owns comparison semantics; native lifecycle remains with go-test-profile and general Go semantics with go-language-profile.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The repository owns dependency selection, exact version, option packages, tolerance, ignores, commands, diagnostics, and rollback.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on ambiguous options, nondeterministic comparers, hidden required behavior, unsafe unexported access, unjustified tolerance, or protected diffs.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Exact v0.7.0 source-derived fixture and cross-owner static dogfood.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: No target module or external dependency execution was performed in APG41.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the profile integration surfaces and repair references to project-owned comparison policy without changing a target dependency.

provisional_readiness.name: go-language-profile
provisional_readiness.trigger: Apply when Go structure, errors, context, interfaces, concurrency, public APIs, reflection, unsafe, cgo, subprocess, or compatibility judgment is material.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use for a mechanical edit, generic procedure, or purely native-test or comparison question.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: Native test lifecycle and go-cmp comparison keep their independent owners; process skills retain implementation and review procedure.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The repository owns supported Go versions, configurations, modules, APIs, build tags, cgo, tests, dependencies, and deployment.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on escaping goroutines, ambiguous channel ownership, credible races, hidden material errors, unsafe boundaries, protected-data disclosure, or unsupported claims.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Read-only maintained-source and public-safe fixture review.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: No target build, race, fuzz, benchmark, coverage, cgo, or cross-platform execution was performed.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the leaf and integration surfaces while preserving evaluations and project-owned Go policy.

provisional_readiness.name: go-test-profile
provisional_readiness.trigger: Apply when native testing package lifecycle, placement, subtests, cleanup, TestMain, parallelism, goroutines, examples, benchmarks, fuzzing, selection, or caching is material.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use for ordinary Go implementation, dependency selection, go-cmp option behavior, or generic review procedure.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: Native lifecycle remains independent from Go language semantics and go-cmp comparison semantics; no stack owner or mandatory chain exists.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The repository owns module and file versions, toolchain, placement, commands, race, coverage, fuzzing, benchmarks, workers, platforms, and CI.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on omitted tests, false-pass TestMain behavior, toolchain-only language assumptions, unsafe goroutine reporting, unbounded cleanup, or protected fuzz artifacts.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Frozen native-test fixture plus read-only public-safe cross-profile dogfood.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: No target module was mutated or tested and no broad Go runtime suite was run.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the leaf and every current integration surface, repair references to project-owned native policy, and preserve ADR and phase history.

provisional_readiness.name: minitest-test-profile
provisional_readiness.trigger: Apply when Minitest discovery, assertions, lifecycle, order, filtering, mocks, stubs, plugins, reporters, isolation, or parallel behavior is material.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use for ordinary Ruby, RSpec-only, trivial assertion wording, framework selection, or harness-neutral integration.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: Minitest owns harness behavior; Ruby owns process semantics and test discipline owns real-versus-fake integration truthfulness.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The project owns Ruby and Minitest versions, mocks, plugins, commands, inventory, workers, CI, coverage, resources, and dependencies.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on empty required collection, false-pass assertions, seed-sensitive state, parallel mock or resource collision, failed restoration, unsupported versions, or protected output.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Static source and thirty-six-case public fixture review; no Ruby target execution.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: Minitest, plugins, reporters, subprocesses, filesystems, and databases were not runtime-dogfooded.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the leaf, projection, catalog and route entries, release and inventory surfaces, focused test and fixture while preserving history.

provisional_readiness.name: nix-test-profile
provisional_readiness.trigger: Apply when an exact claim requires selection or qualification of an already project-owned Nix testing surface.
provisional_readiness.non_trigger: Do not use for generic Nix semantics, dependency selection, commands, activation, deployment, or language-only driver and shell questions.
provisional_readiness.owner_boundary: Nix test owns claim-to-surface selection; Nix language, Python, and shell semantics remain independent and all execution authority remains project-owned.
provisional_readiness.project_owned_input: The project owns versions, inputs, systems, commands, sandbox and daemon configuration, builders, caches, budgets, artifacts, activation, and rollback.
provisional_readiness.adverse_or_stop: Stop on evidence-class overclaim, unqualified sandbox or platform claims, empty required tests, unaccepted impurity or cache boundaries, protected-store exposure, or inferred deployment.
provisional_readiness.evidence_class: Exact Nix and Nixpkgs or NixOS source review plus forty public-safe scenarios; no Nix execution.
provisional_readiness.known_limitations: No evaluation, build, flake check, store or cache action, container, virtual machine, activation, deployment, or runtime isolation probe ran.
provisional_readiness.removal_or_rollback: Remove the leaf and adopting integration surfaces, repair surviving references, and change no target Nix configuration, store, or deployment.
